description: Filter large tool outputs to save context window tokens

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL_NAME=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty'); TOOL_RESULT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_result // empty'); RESULT_LEN=${#TOOL_RESULT}; if [ "$RESULT_LEN" -gt 50000 ]; then jq -n --arg msg "Output very large (${RESULT_LEN} chars). Summarize key findings only." '{"systemMessage": $msg}'; exit 0; fi; if [ "$TOOL_NAME" = "Bash" ] && [ "$RESULT_LEN" -gt 5120 ]; then LINES=$(echo "$TOOL_RESULT" | wc -l); jq -n --arg msg "Output: ${LINES} lines. Extract only relevant information." '{"systemMessage": $msg}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

usage: Copy the PostToolUse hook to .claude/settings.json or your profile settings.json. This hook adds a systemMessage when Bash output exceeds 10KB, guiding Claude to summarize rather than repeat verbose output. For outputs >50KB, the guidance is more aggressive. Requires jq.
